test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following chemical compound is used as a yeast de-foaming agent, commonly found in butter, meat, cereals, chewing gum, baked goods, snack foods, dehydrated potatoes and beer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Butylated hydroxyanisole.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Butylated Hydroxyanisole is a white, waxy solid** combination of 2- and 3-tert-butyl-4-hydroxyanisole that has a slight aromatic odour.
 
• It is largely utilised as an** antioxidant and preservative **in food, food packaging, animal feed, cosmetics, as well as rubber and petroleum industries

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Benzene hexachloride** is used in agriculture, forestry, and seed treatment. It's used to get rid of head and body lice. It is utilised in the pharmaceutical industry.
 
• **Chlorobenzoate is a chlorobenzoate** derivative of 3-chlorobenzoic acid. It is structurally similar to a benzoate. This whitish substance is a precursor of **several medications, food additives, and colours.**
 
• **Potassium Nitrate** is a crystalline powder or solid that is clear, **white, or colourless and has a strong, salty flavour.**
